purpose_context: The system's services are currently scattered (Docling on the Mac, MCP and ES on Halob, reconciler undeployed) which makes it fragile and non-portable. This mission packages every service the system needs as a single docker-compose stack deployable as a Portainer stack on Halob, folds the doctor component-health check into the MCP server as a tool, and makes the whole thing host-agnostic so it can be lifted to a more powerful server later. goldberg-raw + the provenance manifest remain the source of truth, so a new host rebuilds its ES corpus via the reconciler.
purpose_tldr: Run the whole system as one portable docker-compose stack (ES, Docling, MCP+doctor, reconciler) deployable via Portainer and liftable to a bigger host.
